name: Guruvayur Sri Krishna Temple – Prasada Oottu
address: Annadanam hall, Guruvayur Sri Krishna Temple
notes: Free daily meal served as prasadam: rice, sambar, avial, pickle, sometimes payasam. Donations welcome but not required. Temple dress code applies.
donate_info: Sponsor the Prasadaoottu online: on the Guruvayur Devaswom site, register, then Donation → Prasadaoottu / Annaprasadam. You can also give at the Devaswom counter. The Devaswom has no agents, so pay only through its official site.

name: Parassinikadavu Sri Muthappan Temple
address: Banks of the Valapattanam river, about 20 km from Kannur town
timing: Daily – free tea and boiled payar all day, free meals at the temple dining hall
notes: Open to people of every faith. Free food and lodging also during the Puthari Thiruvappana festival in early December.

name: Sabarimala Annadanam (Travancore Devaswom Board)
timing: Pilgrim season 16 Nov 2026 – 20 Jan 2027 (temple closed 27–30 Dec)
notes: Kerala sadya with payasam is served at the annadanam for pilgrims this season. Darshan needs online booking. Only during the pilgrimage season.
donate_info: Give to the annadanam fund online through the Travancore Devaswom Board portal (e-kanikka), or contact the Executive Officer, Sabarimala Devaswom: 04735-202028.

name: Chottanikkara Bhagavathy Temple – Annaprasadam
address: Chottanikkara Bhagavathy Temple, about 17 km from Ernakulam
notes: Free lunch for devotees at the annadanam complex. Run by the Cochin Devaswom Board.
donate_info: Annadanam can be booked as an offering (vazhipadu) at the temple counter or through the temple's official website.

name: Vaikom Sree Mahadeva Temple – Prathal
address: Oottupura (dining hall), Vaikom Sree Mahadeva Temple
timing: Daily lunch (Prathal) – confirm the time at the temple
notes: The temple is famous for its daily annadanam. Very large crowds for Vaikathashtami.

name: Gurudwara Sri Guru Singh Sabha – Langar
address: Gurudwara Road, Perumanoor, near Cochin Shipyard
timing: After congregation prayers: Sunday 11 am, Wednesday 7 pm
notes: Kerala's only gurdwara. Free vegetarian langar open to everyone, whatever their religion.

name: Hridayapoorvam lunch – Thiruvananthapuram Medical College
notes: Free home-cooked lunch packets for patients and bystanders, run by DYFI volunteers since 2017. Hospital food arrangements were under review in 2026, so check locally.
donate_info: Lunch packets are cooked by local households. To help, contact your local DYFI unit and offer to cook packets.

name: Hridayapoorvam lunch – Kozhikode Medical College
notes: Free lunch packets for patients and bystanders, collected from local households by DYFI volunteers. Hospital food arrangements were under review in 2026, so check locally.
donate_info: Lunch packets are collected from local households in turn. To help, contact your local DYFI unit and offer to cook packets.

name: District Hospital – free meals for in-patients
timing: Breakfast, lunch and dinner for admitted patients
notes: The district panchayat added free breakfast in June 2026. Lunch and dinner come from community initiatives. For in-patients only.

name: Mannarasala Sree Nagaraja Temple – Annadanam
timing: Daily – confirm the time at the temple
notes: Daily annadanam open to every pilgrim, whatever their background.
donate_info: To give to the Annadanam fund, message the temple's official WhatsApp number +91 6238060751 and they'll explain how.
